title: 자살예방 및 생명존중문화 조성을 위한 법률 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
title_original: 자살예방 및 생명존중문화 조성을 위한 법률 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 3 (Screening and Counseling/Treatment)
(1) The Minister of Health and Welfare and the Governors of provinces and municipalities shall, considering the characteristics of the screening subjects, such as age, gender, and social environment, develop screening tools in accordance with Article 14(2) of the Act.
(2) The Minister of Health and Welfare and the Governors of provinces and municipalities shall distribute the screening tools developed in accordance with Article 1(1) to institutions, organizations, and facilities corresponding to each item of Article 17(1) of the Act.
(3) The head of an institution, organization, or facility that has received the screening tool in accordance with Article 2(2) may conduct screening on individuals who are deemed to require mental health screening. In this case, prior consent must be obtained.
(4) The head of an institution, organization, or facility that has conducted mental health screening in accordance with Article 3(3) shall, if the screening results reveal individuals at risk of suicide (hereinafter referred to as "individuals at risk of suicide") in accordance with Article 4(1) of the Act, inform the individuals at risk of suicide or their guardians, the Mental Health Welfare Center under Article 15 of the "Act on Promotion of Mental Health and Support for Persons with Mental Disorders," or the

Individuals should be directed to receive counseling and treatment at a suicide prevention center or medical institution, etc. (amended May 30, 2017)

⑤ The Minister of Health and Welfare may provide training to the administrators of institutions, organizations, and facilities that conduct mental health screening in accordance with Article 3.
⑥ In addition to the matters stipulated in Articles 1 through 5, the Minister of Health and Welfare shall determine any other matters necessary for mental health screening and counseling/treatment.
